facts.fact: Agence Togo Digital publishes online the structuring elements of the Architecture d'Entreprise Gouvernementale du Togo (AEGT): a vision, twelve orientation statements and governance, general, business and functional principles for the state information system; the page carries no publication date, so the 2026-09-04 retrieval date stands as a ceiling.

note: Capture is truncated mid-way through the functional principles; the page names no finance, tax or payroll system and states no go-live or outage.
